facts.fact: New Era reports that the Electronic Transactions Act of 2019 and its accreditation regulations were the basis on which CRAN accredited the Ministry of Home Affairs as a certification service provider (announced on an unnamed Tuesday of the week of the 3 September 2026 article).

CRAN accredited the Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security as Namibia's first Certification Service Provider under the Act and its accreditation regulations, valid four years; the article dates it only as Tuesday, so the week of its 3 September 2026 publication is used.
